name: ada-wiki
description: Ada Wiki Engine - Parser and renderer for Markdown and other Wiki syntaxes

paragraphs: Ada Wiki is a small library that provides a parser and renderer for Markdown and several other Wiki syntaxes. The library allows to:
The Ada Wiki library is used by Ada Web Application for the implementation of the blog and wiki online plugins and by mdshow a terminal based Markdown viewer.
features: Parse a Markdown text but other Wiki such as Mediawiki, Creole, PhpBB, Dotclear and Google Code,
Parse HTML content in embedded wiki text,
Filter out the wiki, HTML or text through customizable filters,
Render the wiki text in HTML, text or another wiki format.
